Pin_D2_L8.note: d2 x 8 dowel: printed pin, or a 1.75 mm filament piece (looser)

Peg_2.5x8.note: 2.5x8 thermoplastic screw: gimbal (with the washer) 5, finger frames -> plate 3 per digit, back shell -> hand adapter 2

Peg_2.5x16.note: back shell -> palm plate ribs (2.5x16 thermoplastic screws)

Peg_2.5x6.note: hand adapter -> palm plate legs (2.5x6 thermoplastic screws)

Dummy_SCS0009.note: servo stand-in; its ear holes (d2.0) take 1.75 mm filament pins into the finger frames

Mock_Horn.note: cross horn + the stud's nut; slides onto the Dummy_SCS0009 stub (friction)

Stud_Pin_D2.1_L8.note: the horn's ball stud: pressed through the arm and its boss, flush below; a Ball_D5 pressed on top

Ball_D5.note: d5 ball, pressed flush on the end of a Link axle (2 per Link) or a horn's stud pin (1 per horn)

Axle_D2.1_L20.note: through the Link's d2.2 ball-stud hole, a Ball_D5 pressed on each end

Pin_D3_L10.note: d3 x 10 gimbal pin (press into the ring)

Ball_Stud_Top.note: M3 ball stud stand-in, a pin printed lying down: shank presses into the lever bar's insert hole; a Ball_D5.8 pressed flush on the neck
